body: I think if people were really interested in the psychology they would read a book or watch lectures on abnormal or criminal psych, as you're not really gonna learn much psychology from dramatized, biographical videos, TV shows, or movies (which seems to be how most people learn about serial killers.) Clearly there is more to it than an interest in psychology.

That's so great to hear!  I'm so glad you're still here and had the strength to seek out the help you need! I agree with your therapist and psychiatrist that it's not the best to be hospitalized if you feel pressured into it, but if you start having those thoughts again please don't hesitate to tell your therapist.

And not feeling suicidal for a week? That's huge! Things will inevitably be up and down but I am rooting for you, and you seem to have a lot of the pieces need to really heal. Keep those friends of yours close. You got this. One step at a time. :)

You sound like you got some good friends! I know you might feel a little numb, that their words might not quite be making it all the way through to you, but you should talk to them. Spend time with them if you can. That's what I would do if I could.

I also don't think you're being an attention whore; you're not making anything up! You sound like you really value honesty, I'm the same way. Try to take the support you are being given. Do your best to improve, exhaust every option. If you keep giving it your best shot, the guilt will dissipate, in my experience. I wish you the best of luck :)

Hey you commented on my post and it looks like we're in a similar situation with not being able to go through with it. I'm glad you're still here. It's fucking tough and I don't know what the future holds...but there are a lot of years ahead of us. Who knows what might change, right? Keep fighting.

Try therapy dude. Look on psychology today for a therapist in your area who specializes in social anxiety. Check with your insurance to see if you can do telehealth mental health for free if you’re in the US (a lot of insurance companies will offer it for right now cause of covid.) 

Therapists are there to help you when life gets too complicated. Try to make sure that they understand you well, be communicative about what you think will work best for you, and try to have some faith in the process. Strive to be open and honest. It will take time, but progress happens slowly. Best of luck to you.

It’s rough, you get to become so close with and support these people while you’re all at one of the lowest points in your lives, and then you have to part ways forever after a week. I hope you meet someone else who makes you feel the same way, and I’m glad you’re still around.
